info.title: Pensa Mobile API
info.description: API to support the needs of the Pensa mobile app.

get.description:
Retrieve the permissions and account details for a user logging into the app. 
Requires a valid authentication token.

schema.description:
The application type for which permissions are requested. 
Possible values: 
- `MOBILE`: Requires permissions
- `MOBILESDK`: Requires permissions

200.description: Successful response containing permissions and account details.

group_id.description: The group ID associated with the user.

mobile_app_idle_timeout.description: A mobile app login session will time out after this many seconds of inactivity.

roles.description: List of roles assigned to the user.

get.description:
Retrieve the logo for a specific category as a PNG or a JPG image.
Requires a valid `category ID` and a valid authentication token.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: The ID of the category whose logo is being retrieved.

204.description: No Content. The category does not have a logo.

get.summary: Get User's Recent Fast Out-of-Stock Products
get.description:
Returns the lists of out-of-stock products for each shift the user completed during the last 7 days.
Requires a valid authentication token.

200.description: List of recent fast out-of-stock products retrieved successfully.

get.description:
Returns the lists of out-of-stock products for each shift a scanner completed during the last 7 days.
Requires a valid authentication token.

200.description: List of recent fast out-of-stock products retrieved successfully.

post.summary: Add or update SSP product restock statuses
post.description:
Creates or updates SSP product restock statuses.
If `status` is `CANT_RESTOCK`, then `cant_restock_reason` is required.
Requires a valid authentication token and the user to have the `STOCK` role.

requestBody.description: A list of product restock statuses to create or update.

cant_restock_reason.description: Reason why the product can't be restocked. Required if `status` is `CANT_RESTOCK`.

get.summary: Get Fast Out-of-Stock Products for Shelf Scan Period
get.description:
Returns the list of unexpectedly out-of-stock products for a completed shelf scan period.
Requires a valid `shelf_scan_period_id` and a valid authentication token.

parameters.name: shelf_scan_period_id
parameters.description: The ID of the shelf scan period for which fast-out-of-stock products are being requested.

200.description: Successfully retrieved fast-out-of-stock products.

get.description:
Returns a list of banners. The data returned will be restricted based on the user's access entitlements.
Requires a valid authentication token.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the banners.

active.description: Whether the banner is currently active.

channel_type.description: Type of channel associated with the banner.

report_failed_scans.description: Whether failed scans are reported for the banner.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of retailers. The response can be filtered and limited using query parameters.
Requires a valid authentication token.

200.description: Successful response containing a list of retailers.

active.description: Indicates if the retailer is active.

get.description:
Returns a list of active scan areas, optionally filtered by retailer, banner, store, or shelf ID.
Requires a valid authentication token.

200.description: Successful response containing a list of scan areas.

active.description: Indicates whether the scan area is active.

scored.description: Indicates whether the scan area is scored.

get.description:
Retrieve a list of shelves that can be scanned by the mobile app, optionally filtered by retailer, banner, or store.
Requires a valid authentication token.

200.description: Successful response containing scannable shelves.

onboarding.description: Indicates if the shelf is used for onboarding.

scored.description: Indicates if the shelf has scoring enabled.

semantic_audit_trigger_event.description: Event that triggers a semantic audit.

get.description:
Retrieve a list of shelf categories.
Requires a valid authentication token.

200.description: Successful response containing shelf categories.

get.description:
Returns a list of active stores, optionally filtered by retailer or banner.
Requires a valid authentication token.

200.description: Successful response containing store details.

get.description:
Returns a list of stores ordered by distance from a specified latitude/longitude position and radius
in kilometers, nearest first. By default, returns up to 5 stores within approximately 5 miles (8 km).
Requires a valid authentication token.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in kilometers. Defaults to approximately 5 miles (8 km).

200.description: Successful response containing stores ordered by distance from the location.

get.description:
Retrieves store details using a specific TDLinx code.
Requires a valid authentication token and the user to have the `SCAN` role.

parameters.name: tdlinx_code
parameters.description: The TDLinx code of the store being requested.

200.description: Successfully retrieved store details.

city.description: The city where the store is located.

country.description: The country where the store is located.

postal_code.description: The postal code of the store.

state.description: The state where the store is located.

street.description: The street address of the store.

get.summary: Retrieve stores, shelves, and scan areas
get.description:
Returns a list of requested stores, including their active shelves and scan areas.
**Note:** At least one of `stores` or `tdlinx_codes` must be provided.
Requires a valid authentication token.

parameters.name: tdlinx_codes
parameters.description:
Comma-separated list of TDLinx codes of the stores to filter by.
Example: `3865679,3865682`

parameters.name: include_all_eligible
parameters.description: Include shelves that are not due but are still eligible for scanning.

200.description: Successful response containing stores, shelves, and scan areas details.

last_scan_username.description: Username of the last scan user.

scan_due_date.description: Due date for the scan in YYYY-MM-DD format.

scan_eligible_end_date.description: End date of scan eligibility in YYYY-MM-DD format.

scan_eligible_start_date.description: Start date of scan eligibility in YYYY-MM-DD format.

scan_is_due.description: Whether the shelf scan is due.

scan_is_eligible.description: Whether the shelf is eligible for scanning.

scan_is_overdue.description: Whether the shelf scan is overdue.

store_section_customer_key.description: Customer key for the store section, if applicable.

get.summary: Retrieve stores, shelves, and scan areas by group
get.description:
Returns a list of stores, including their `active` shelves and scan areas grouped by store. 
**Note**: When ordering by something other than `id`, both `after_id` and `after_value` must be provided, or neither.
Requires a valid authentication token.

parameters.name: include_all_eligible
parameters.description: Include shelves not due but eligible for scanning.

parameters.name: after_value
parameters.description: Used in conjunction with `after_id` for ordering by columns other than `id`.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Column to order results by. Allowed values: `id`, `store_name`.

parameters.name: order_dir
parameters.description: Sorting direction. Allowed values: `ASC`, `DESC`.

200.description: Successful response containing stores, shelves, and scan areas grouped by store.

shelves.description: List of shelves in the store.

scan_areas.description: List of scan areas for the shelf.

get.summary: Get active stores with partial products.
get.description:
Returns all nearby active stores having partial products, along with the count of partial products per store. 
The required "latitude" and "longitude" parameters specify from which point to measure nearby stores.
Requires a valid authentication token and the user to have the `INGEST_PARTIAL` role.

200.description: Successful response containing stores with partial products and their counts.

data.description: List of stores with partial products.

partial_product_count.description: Count of partial products in the store.

post.summary: Onboard a store by creating shelves and scan areas.
post.description:
Onboards a store by creating main, end cap, and checkout shelves and scan areas.
The user must have the `ONBOARD` role and access to the store to perform this action.
The `main`, `endcap`, and `checkout` fields are required.
Requires a valid `store_id` and a valid authentication token.

parameters.name: main
parameters.description: Number of main shelves to create.

parameters.name: endcap
parameters.description: Number of endcap shelves to create.

parameters.name: checkout
parameters.description: Number of checkout shelves to create.

get.summary: Get store sections for a specific store.
get.description:
Retrieves store sections for a specific store.
Requires a valid `store_id` and a valid authentication token.

200.description: Successfully retrieved store section details.

post.summary: Creates a new shelf for a store.
post.description:
Creates a new shelf for a store.
The user must have the `ADD_SHELF` role and access to the store to perform this action.
Requires a valid `store_id` and a valid authentication token.

200.description: Successful. The response contains shelves details.

get.description:
Returns the list of projects to which a user belongs, optionally filtered by store id.
Requires a valid authentication token.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: The ID of the store for which user wants to filter by the projects which allow the store.

200.description: Successfully retrieved user's projects.

start_date.description: The start date of the project in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: The end date of the project in YYYY-MM-DD format.

shelf_grouping_type.description: The type of shelf grouping for the project.

shelf_category_ids.description: IDs of the associated shelf categories.

product_category_ids.description: IDs of the associated product categories.

id.description: The ID of the report instance.

name.description: The name of the report instance within the project.

report_id.description: The ID of the report definition.

allowed_scanner_account_ids.description: IDs of the scanner accounts whose scans can be used for reporting.

custom_product_attribute_ids.description: IDs of the custom product attributes to be included in the report.

ignored_scanner_account_ids.description: IDs of the scanner accounts whose scans cannot be used for reporting.

get.description:
Returns the list of rescans needed for the user by stores.
Requires a valid authentication token and the user to have the `SCAN` role.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the rescan report for the user.

items.description: Details about the stores included in the rescan report.

get.description:
Checks the availability of the service. 
Requires a valid authentication token.

Retrieves a list of product categories available to the user. 
Requires a valid authentication token.

200.description: Successfully retrieved product categories.

department_id.description: Identifier for the department the category belongs to.

department_name.description: Name of the department the category belongs to.

subcategory_count.description: Number of subcategories within the category.

get.summary: Get Product Categories with Partial Products
get.description:
Returns all categories having un-locked, un-captured partial products, along with the count of partial products per category.
Requires a valid authentication token and the user to have the `INGEST_PARTIAL` role.

200.description: Successfully retrieved product categories with partial products.

partial_product_count.description: Count of partial products in the category.

post.description:
Captures a partial product by setting the captured timestamp and the image s3 key.
Requires a valid `partial_product_id`, a valid authentication token and the user to have the `INGEST_PARTIAL` role.

200.description: Successfully captured the partial product.

400.description: Bad Request. Partial product locked by another user. Invalid or missing required fields.

example.error: Bad Request. Partial product locked by another user. Invalid or missing fields.

post.description:
Locks a partial product for the user making the request. 
Requires a valid `partial_product_id`, a valid authentication token and the user to have the `INGEST_PARTIAL` role.

200.description: Successfully locked the partial product.

lock_status.description: Lock status of the partial product.

400.description: Bad Request. Partial product locked by another user. Invalid or missing required fields.

example.error: Bad Request. Partial product locked by another user. Invalid or missing fields.

post.description:
Unlocks the specified partial product for the user making the request. 
Requires a valid `partial_product_id`, a valid authentication token and the user to have the `INGEST_PARTIAL` role.

200.description: Successfully unlocked the partial product.

lock_status.description: Lock status of the partial product.

post.description:
Allows uploading new UPC codes and S3 image keys for product ingestion.
Requires a valid authentication token and the user to have the `INGEST_NEW` role.

requestBody.description: JSON payload to create a new product ingest.

comment.description: Additional comments about the product ingest, if any.

error_message.description: Error message, if any occurred during the ingest.

height.description: The height of the product, if applicable.

id.description: The unique identifier for the product ingest record.

image_crop_height.description: Cropped height of the product image, if applicable.

image_crop_left.description: Left offset for the cropped product image, if applicable.

image_crop_top.description: Top offset for the cropped product image, if applicable.

image_crop_width.description: Cropped width of the product image, if applicable.

owner_id.description: The ID of the owner of the product ingest, if applicable.

rotation_angle.description: Rotation angle of the product image, if applicable.

status.description: The current status of the product ingest.

version.description: The version number of the product ingest record.

width.description: The width of the product, if applicable.

409.description: Conflict. The provided store ID does not exist in the database.

error.example: Store with ID 5 does not exist

get.summary: Get categories with partial products for a specific store.
get.description:
Returns all categories in a store that contain un-locked partial products, along with the count of partial products per category. 
Only `un-captured` products will be included in the response.
Requires a valid authentication token and the user to have the `INGEST_PARTIAL` role.

200.description: Successful response containing categories with un-locked partial products.

partial_products.description: List of partial products within the category.

accepted_by.description: Name of the user who accepted the partial product.

captured_by.description: Name of the user who captured the partial product.

country_code.description: Country code associated with the partial product.

created_by.description: Name of the user who created the partial product.

height.description: Height of the product in centimeters.

image_full_s3_key.description: S3 key for the full image of the partial product.

last_locked_by.description: Name of the user who last locked the partial product.

last_seen.description: Date when the partial product was last observed in YYYY-MM-DD format.

thumbnail_s3_key.description: S3 key for the thumbnail image of the partial product.

width.description: Width of the product in centimeters.

get.summary: Get the last observed scan frame for a partial product.
get.description:
Retrieves the last observed scan frame for the specified partial product in a store.
Returns the image file directly.
Requires a valid authentication token and the user to have the `INGEST_PARTIAL` role.

get.summary: Get shelves with partial products for a specific store.
get.description:
Returns all shelves in a store that contain partial products, along with the count of partial products per shelf.
Allows filtering by categories and manufacturers.
Requires a valid authentication token and the user to have the `INGEST_PARTIAL` role.

200.description: Successful response containing shelves with partial products for a store.

get.summary: Validate and normalize a new UPC.
get.description:
Checks and normalizes the UPC for a potential new product. If the UPC is valid and does not already exist, a normalized UPC is returned.
For traditionally ingested products, duplicates are not allowed, but for partial products, duplicates are permitted.
Requires a valid authentication token and the user to have the `INGEST` role.

parameters.name: upc
parameters.description: The UPC code to validate and normalize.

parameters.name: is_partial_product
parameters.description: Specifies whether the UPC is for a partial product. If true, duplicate UPCs are allowed.

200.description: OK. Returns a normalized UPC if the input UPC is valid and eligible.

normalized_upc.description: The normalized GTIN-14 format of the UPC.

409.description: Conflict. A product with the normalized UPC already exists.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. The UPC cannot be normalized or is invalid.

error.description: Error message explaining the validation error.
error.example: UPC validation failed: Check digit is invalid.

get.summary: Get the default reference image for a product.
get.description:
Returns the default reference image for a specified product in JPEG format.
Requires a valid `product_id` and a valid authentication token.

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: The ID of the product for which the default reference image is requested.

post.description:
Refreshes the access token using a valid refresh token. Both access and refresh tokens must be provided in the headers.
If the tokens are valid and not expired, a new access token is returned.

200.description: Token refreshed successfully. Returns a new access token.

token.description: The refreshed tokens and their details.

expires_in.description: The expiration time of the access token in seconds.

id_token.description: The ID token associated with the session.

refresh_expires_in.description: The expiration time of the refresh token in seconds.

scope.description: The scope of the access token.

get.description:
Returns the report of rejected scans for the caller.
Requires a valid authentication token and the user to have the `SCAN` role.

200.description: Scan rejection report retrieved successfully.

all_time_reject_count.description: Total number of rejected scans over all time.

all_time_upload_count.description: Total number of uploaded scans over all time.

top_reason_list.description: List of top reasons for rejections.

week_list.description: Weekly scan rejection and upload statistics.

day_list.description: Daily scan statistics within the week.

end_date.description: End date of the week in YYYY-MM-DD format.

reject_count.description: Number of rejected scans in the week.

start_date.description: Start date of the week in YYYY-MM-DD format.

upload_count.description: Number of uploaded scans in the week.

get.summary: Get a signed URL for an S3 key.
get.description:
Returns a signed URL for an S3 key, allowing secure access to files in S3 storage.
The `key` request parameter is required. Optionally, a `filename` parameter can be provided to set a custom filename for the download.
Requires a valid authentication token and the user to have the `SCAN` role.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The S3 key for the file to generate the signed URL for.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Optional custom filename for the download.

200.description: Successfully generated a signed URL for the requested S3 key.

url.description: The signed S3 URL for the requested key.

get.summary: Get final scan frame image for a scan area.
get.description:
Returns an image of the last scan frame in the latest scan for the specified scan area.
Requires a valid authentication token and the user to have the `SCAN` role.

get.summary: Get first scan frame image for a scan area.
get.description:
Returns an image of the first scan frame in the latest scan for the specified scan area.
Requires a valid authentication token and the user to have the `SCAN` role.

post.description:
Creates a new scan record and an associated shelf_scan_period record if necessary.
Requires a valid authentication token and the user to have the `SCAN` role.

To submit a session scan, include `session_scan: true`. In that mode the payload **must** contain
`store_id` and either `guid` or `customer_tracking_id`, `scan_area_id` must be omitted, and the only supported
`capture_type` is `IMAGE`. When `session_scan` is `false` or not provided, `scan_area_id` is required and
`store_id` must be omitted.

scan_timestamp.description:
The timestamp of when the scan occurred, represented as a Unix timestamp in string format.
The backend will deserialize this into an ISO8601 format.

publish.description: Indicates whether the scan is to be published.

session_scan.description:
Indicates whether the scan belongs to a stateless session. Defaults to `false`. When `true`,
`store_id` and `guid` (or `customer_tracking_id`) are required and `scan_area_id` must be omitted.

guid.description: Optional external identifier supplied by the client. Required when `session_scan` is `true` unless `customer_tracking_id` is provided.

customer_tracking_id.description: Alternate external identifier for the scan. If both `guid` and `customer_tracking_id` are present, `guid` takes precedence.

has_out_of_service_segment.description: Indicates if the scan has an out-of-service segment.

image_width.description: Width of the images captured during the scan.

image_height.description: Height of the images captured during the scan.

frame_capture_rate.description: Frame capture rate during the scan.

200.description: Scan successfully created.

fast_status.description: Current processing status of the scan.

frame_height.description: Height of the frames captured during the scan.

frame_width.description: Width of the frames captured during the scan.

has_out_of_service_segment.description: Indicates whether the scan includes an out-of-service segment.

publish.description: Indicates if the scan is published.

focal_length.description: Focal length used in the scan.

frame_capture_rate.description: Frame capture rate during the scan.

guid.description: Unique identifier for the scan session.

ignore_late_upload.description: Indicates whether late uploads are ignored.

mobile_capture_completed.description: Timestamp when mobile capture was completed, represented as a Unix timestamp in string format.

pause_list.description: List of pauses during the scan process.

server_upload_started.description: Timestamp when the server upload started in ISO 8601 format.

post.description:
Proxies a request to the Scan service to create a new session identified by the provided client-supplied identifier.
Requires a valid authentication token and the user to have the `SCAN` role.

guid.description: Client-supplied identifier for the scan session. UUIDs are accepted, but not required.

schema.description: Response payload forwarded from the Scan service.

post.description:
Proxies a request to the Scan service to finalize an existing session. Requires a valid authentication token
and the `SCAN` role.

guid.description: Identifier for the session to be finalized. UUIDs are accepted, but not required.

200.description: Scan session finalized.

schema.description: Response payload forwarded from the Scan service.

get.description: Returns scan session details by proxying the request to the Scan service. Requires the `SCAN` role.

parameters.name: guid
parameters.description: Identifier of the scan session to fetch.

200.description: Scan session metadata.

schema.description: Response payload forwarded from the Scan service.

get.description:
Returns the current report status (and download URL when available) for a scan session by proxying the request
to the Scan service. Requires the `SCAN` role.

parameters.name: guid
parameters.description: Identifier of the scan session report to retrieve.

200.description: Scan session report status.

schema.description: Response payload forwarded from the Scan service.

get.summary: Get Scan Capture Qualities for a Shelf
get.description:
Retrieves the allowed scan capture qualities for a specific shelf.
Requires a valid `shelf_id`, a valid authentication token and the user to have the `SCAN` role.

parameters.name: shelf_id
parameters.description: The ID of the shelf for which scan capture qualities are being requested.

200.description: Successfully retrieved scan capture qualities.

get.summary: Get Scan Capture Qualities for a Store
get.description:
Retrieves the `allowed` scan capture qualities for all `active` shelves in a specified store.
Requires a valid `store_id`, a valid authentication token and the user to have the `SCAN` role.

200.description: Successfully retrieved scan capture qualities for the store.

shelves.description: List of shelves with their respective scan capture qualities.

get.summary: Get Start Image of a Scan
get.description:
Retrieves an image of the first frame in a specified scan.
Requires a valid `scan_id`, a valid authentication token and the user to have the `SCAN` role.

204.description: No Content. No scan frame exists for the given `scan_id`.

post.description:
Informs the system that all scan assets for a specified scan have been successfully uploaded to S3.
Either `scan_key` or `image_keys` should be provided, but not both.
Requires a valid `scan_id`, a valid authentication token and the user to have the `SCAN` role.

mobile_upload_started.description:
The timestamp when the mobile upload began, represented as a Unix timestamp in string format.
The backend will deserialize this into an ISO8601 format.

mobile_upload_completed.description:
The timestamp when the mobile upload was completed, represented as a Unix timestamp in string format.
The backend will deserialize this into an ISO8601 format.

scan_key.description: The unique key identifying the uploaded scan in S3.

image_keys.description: List of keys for images uploaded to S3.

scan_media_size_megabytes.description: Size of the uploaded scan media in megabytes.

post.description:
Sends device logs as email attachments to the specified email address or the default `mobile-logs@pensasystems.com`.
Requires a valid `device_uuid`, a file containing logs in a `.zip` format, and a valid authentication token.
**Important:** 
- Ensure that the environment variable `OUTGOING_EMAIL_ACCOUNT_SSM_KEY` is properly configured and accessible. 
- This variable should point to the SSM key for retrieving the outgoing email account credentials.

to_email_address.description: The recipient's email address. Defaults to `mobile-logs@pensasystems.com` if not provided.

204.description: No Content. Device logs have been successfully sent.

post.description:
Records when a scanner user enters a store. Stores scanners in stores by shift and associates them with the appropriate scan period.
Requires a valid `store_id` and a valid authentication token.

scanner_username.description: The username of the scanner entering the store.

201.description: Created. Successfully recorded the store entry.

scanner_user_id.description: The ID of the scanner user.

get.description:
Retrieves the logo image for a specified store. If the store does not have a logo, it retrieves the retailer's logo.
Requires a valid `store_id` and a valid authentication token.

X-Pensa-ID-Token.name: x-pensa-id-token
X-Pensa-ID-Token.description:
The ID Token, retrieved from cookies, is refreshed if expired. 
If all tokens expire, reauthentication is required. 
It identifies the user for accessing protected resources.

X-Pensa-Access-Token.name: x-pensa-access-token
X-Pensa-Access-Token.description:
The Access Token, retrieved from cookies, authorizes access to protected resources. 
If expired, it is refreshed using the Refresh Token. 
It represents the user's permissions for a session.

X-Pensa-Refresh-Token.name: x-pensa-refresh-token
X-Pensa-Refresh-Token.description:
The Refresh Token, retrieved from cookies, is used to obtain a new Access Token when the current one expires. 
If expired, reauthentication is required. 
It extends the session without requiring the user to log in again.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: The maximum number of results to return.

After-ID.name: after_id
After-ID.description: Return only records with an ID greater than this value.

Include-Inactive.name: include_inactive
Include-Inactive.description: Include inactive records in the response, in addition to the active records. Defaults to `false`.

Banners.name: banners
Banners.description:
Comma-separated list of banner IDs to filter by.
Example: `10,20`

Categories.name: categories
Categories.description:
Comma-separated list of category IDs to filter by.
Example: `123,456,789`

Manufacturers.name: manufacturers
Manufacturers.description:
Comma-separated list of manufacturer IDs to filter by.
Example: `121,212`

PartialProductId.name: partial_product_id
PartialProductId.description: The ID of the partial product.

Retailers.name: retailers
Retailers.description:
Comma-separated list of retailer IDs to filter by.
Example: `1,2`

ScanAreaId.name: scan_area_id
ScanAreaId.description: The ID of the scan area.

StoreSearchText.name: search_text
StoreSearchText.description: Filter stores by name, banner name, or address containing this text. Case insensitive.

Shelves.name: shelves
Shelves.description:
Comma-separated list of shelf IDs to filter by.
Example: `111,222`

Stores.name: stores
Stores.description:
Comma-separated list of store IDs to filter by.
Example: `101,202`

AcceptedByUserId.description: User ID of the user who accepted the partial product (if applicable).

ActiveShelf.description: Indicates whether the shelf is active.

ActiveStore.description: Indicates whether the store is active.

Aisle.description: Aisle of the associated scan area.

AllowDynamicShelfScanning.description: Whether dynamic shelf scanning is allowed.
